items.reason: A gentle cleanser that won't strip skin that already looks dry.
A milder 0.3% retinol to start with, to help skin look smoother and more even without overdoing it.
A rich ceramide cream to support comfort and moisture on dry-looking skin.
Tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides to protect skin and keep dark patches from looking deeper, and it's needed alongside retinol.

response.routine_note: The 30% peel and the 1% retinol were left out because using them together is likely to irritate, and harsh exfoliation can leave deeper skin tones looking more uneven, so start with the 0.3% retinol two to three nights a week and wear the tinted SPF every morning. If the dark patches on your cheeks persist, spread or bother you, a dermatologist is the right person to ask rather than a stronger product from a shop.
